system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:40 UTC, Maria Lopez ran PowerShell to compress \\FILE-HD-01\Shared\Clients into C:\Users\maria.lopez\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip; Sysmon then recorded creation of that archive.

At 13:45:59 UTC, the proxy recorded a CONNECT tunnel from WS-MLOPEZ-01 to sendbox-files.io with 51,000,000 client-to-server bytes; Zeek recorded approximately the same outbound volume for that connection.
The corresponding workstation network event identifies Firefox running as maria.lopez and connecting to the explicit proxy on the same source port as the transfer.

The archive creation followed by a roughly 51 MB outbound tunnel to a file-transfer domain not listed among the organization's approved services strongly supports deliberate data exfiltration rather than an approved backup or routine application update.

known_telemetry_limitations: The transfer is logged as a CONNECT tunnel; these records do not show the upload URL, uploaded filename, or application-layer contents (T009-00192, T009-00193).
The records establish archive creation and outbound volume but do not establish the archive's size, contents, or exact relationship to the tunneled bytes (T009-00160, T009-00162, T009-00192).
The available evidence does not show whether the remote service accepted or retained the data.
claims_not_established: The exact files included in c.zip and whether they contained client-sensitive information.
Whether Maria Lopez had authorization or a legitimate business reason to transfer these files.
Who controls sendbox-files.io, who received the data, and whether the remote service retained it.
Whether the 51,000,000 client-to-server tunnel bytes consisted entirely of the created archive.
additional_evidence_needed: Preserve and examine c.zip, including its size, hash, contents, and relevant filesystem timestamps.
Collect FILE-HD-01 SMB or file-access auditing for the Shared\Clients path to identify files read during archive creation.
Obtain proxy TLS inspection, upload request, DNS, and destination-IP/provider records for sendbox-files.io to determine the uploaded object and recipient.
Confirm with Maria Lopez and relevant business owners whether the transfer was authorized, and preserve any supporting business records.
